# AAC format fixtures

These are original synthetic 0.5-second tones, generated by `generate.py` with
[FDK AAC v2.0.3](https://github.com/mstorsjo/fdk-aac/tree/v2.0.3), commit
`716f4394641d53f0d79c9ddac3fa93b03a49f278`. No recorded audio is included.
`manifest.json` records requested profiles, rates, channels and SHA-256 hashes.
FFprobe independently identifies the LC, HE-AAC and HE-AACv2 profiles.

Build the upstream `aac-enc` example, then regenerate with:

```sh
python3 tests/fixtures/aac_stream_format/generate.py /path/to/aac-enc
```

LC fixtures keep 128 kbit/s across rate/channel changes. HE uses 64 kbit/s;
HEv2 uses 32 kbit/s and a mono AAC core with stereo reconstructed by PS.
The left/right tones differ and include energy above the 22.05 kHz core's
Nyquist frequency in the full-rate fixtures. Encoder delay adds frames beyond
the original half-second input; tests count the actual decoded frames.

Used by `tests/run-esp32c3-stream-format.py` (real Helix, SBR synthesis disabled)
and the C3 QEMU AAC regression (actual Espressif AAC Plus decoder). The latter
also records the implicit SBR/PS transition limitation and verifies recovery
when a new stream opens.
